home.heroTitle: Gupima agaciro k'ubutaka neza bishingiye ku makuru ya leta
home.heroSubtitle: Shyikirana n'abaguzi bizewe — abakoresha diaspora n'abashoramari bo mu mahanga. Bona ibiciro byihuse bishingiye ku bipimo by'akarere, kugenzura inyandiko z'ubutaka, n'ibintu bibera ku isoko.
home.officialGazettePrices: Amahitamo y'Igiciro ya Gazeti ya Leta

features.title: Kuki uhitamo LVS
features.heading: Yubakiwe isoko ry'ubutaka mu Rwanda
features.subtitle: Guhuza gazeti, kumenya aho biherereye neza, no guhuza abaguzi mu buryo butaziguye.

gazette.title: Amakuru ya Gazeti ya Leta
gazette.desc: Ibipimo byo ku murwa bituruka kuri Rwanda Land Authority, bigahindurwa buri kwezi kwa gatatu.

maps.title: Akarita y'Imiturire
maps.desc: Shushanya imipaka, pima intera, reba uko imiturire igabanijwe.

evolution.title: Ubwiyongere bw'Igiciro
evolution.desc: Amateka y'ibiciro n'ibanze ry'imyaka 5 kugirango ushore neza.

features.zoneHeading: Ahantu hose, gushyira mu byiciro byihuse
features.zoneDesc: Kanda ku karita cyangwa wandike aho uherereye. Moteri yacu ireba mu turere twa gazeti y'u Rwanda (umujyi, icyaro, ubuhinzi, ibishanga) maze ikabara igipimo shingiro.

steps.title: Intambwe enye ziganisha ku gukora ubucuruzi bw'ubutaka
steps.step1Desc: Shyiramo indangantego cyangwa shyira inyandiko z'ubutaka
steps.step2Desc: Formula ya gazeti + iboneza ry'isoko + amateka
steps.step3Desc: Shyikirana n'abaguzi bakomeye (diaspora, bo mu gihugu)
steps.step4Desc: Inkunga yo guhererekanya inyandiko n'ububiko bw'ishyurwa

homePage.testimonialQuote: "Nk'umushoramari wo muri diaspora, nari nkenera agaciro k'ubutaka kizewe. LVS yampaye icyizere gishingiye kuri gazeti ikanhuza n'umucuruzi i Kigali mu cyumweru kimwe."
homePage.ctaTitle: Witeguye gupima agaciro cyangwa kugurisha ubutaka bwawe?
homePage.ctaSubtitle: Hura n'ibihumbi by'abanyarwanda n'abashoramari bo ku isi yose bakoresha urubuga rwizewe.

howItWorks.title: Intambwe 4 Zoroshye Ziganisha ku Bucuruzi bw'Ubutaka
howItWorks.subtitle: Menya uburyo LandVal yoroshya gupima agaciro n'ibikorwa by'ubutaka mu Rwanda ikoresheje amakuru ya leta, ikoranabuhanga rigezweho, n'inkunga idasanzwe.
howItWorks.demoDesc: Kanda akarere urebe icyitegererezo cy'igipimo cy'agaciro. Gupima nyakuri gukoresha amakuru ya gazeti nyayo n'isesengura ry'isoko.
howItWorks.stepsSubtitle: Kurikiza ubu buryo bworoshye kugirango urangize ubucuruzi bwawe bw'ubutaka wizewe
howItWorks.step1Desc: Iyandikishe mu masegonda ngo uhabwe ibiranga byose utangire urugendo rwawe.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Shyiramo UPI cyangwa aho uherereye kugirango ubone agaciro k'ubutaka mu kanya.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Bona igipimo cy'agaciro gifite ibipimo bya gazeti n'isesengura.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Shyira imiturire ku isoko, huza n'abaguzi, cyangwa tanga igiciro ufite inkunga y'ububiko bw'ishyurwa.
howItWorks.featuresSubtitle: Ntayo ndi yo guhinduranya ibikoresho — LandVal ibizana byose hamwe
howItWorks.feature1Desc: Shaka kuri nomero ya parisa, izina rya nyir'ubutaka, aderesi, cyangwa ukande kuri karita.
howItWorks.feature2Desc: Ibiciro bivugururwa, ibikorwa by'ubucuruzi, n'ibyifuzo by'isoko kugirango ufate ibyemezo byiza.
howItWorks.feature3Desc: Igipimo cy'agaciro k'ubutaka gishingiye ku bipimo bya gazeti ya leta.
howItWorks.feature4Desc: Menya iyo imiturire mu karere ufite intego iboneye igiciro kijyanye n'ingengo yawe.
howItWorks.feature5Desc: Ibiteganijwe by'inyungu, kubara inyungu ku mushinge, n'igipimo cy'ingaruka.
howItWorks.feature6Desc: Itsinda ry'inkunga riba ryiteguriye gufasha mu kiganiro, imeli, cyangwa terefone.
howItWorks.ctaSubtitle: Unyure mu batubarwa bakoresheje LandVal kugirango borohereze ubucuruzi bw'ubutaka
howItWorks.ctaDisclaimer: Nta karita ya banki ikenewe · Gupima agaciro gatatu ku Ubuntu

benefits.title: Inyungu 10 Zikomeye
benefits.subtitle: Menya uburyo LandVal ihindura isoko ry'ubutaka mu Rwanda ikoresheje amakuru ya leta, ikoranabuhanga rigezweho, n'inkunga idasanzwe
benefits.sectionSubtitle: Buri kintu cyakozwe kugirango bicyoroshye, byizewe, kandi byunguke
benefits.benefit1Desc: Guhuza n'amakuru ya gazeti ya Rwanda Land Authority, ivugururwa buri kwezi kwa gatatu kugirango ibe nyayo cyane.
benefits.benefit1Metric: 15-25% by'inyongera ugereranije n'ibipimo bitari bya gazeti
benefits.benefit2Desc: Bona igiciro nyacyo cy'ubutaka munsi y'amasegonda 30 ukoresheje uburyo bwa algoritme n'amakuru y'isoko y'igihe nyacyo.
benefits.benefit2Metric: Bika igihe kugeza kuri 95% yo gupima agaciro
benefits.benefit3Desc: Huza n'Abanyarwanda 500,000+ bari hanze y'igihugu n'abashoramari mpuzamahanga bashaka ubutaka mu Rwanda.
benefits.benefit4Desc: Ibikoresho by'akarita by'umwuga byerekana imipaka, ibiciro by'akarere, ingaruka z'umwuzure, n'ibikorwa remezo.
benefits.benefit5Desc: Amakuru y'imyaka 10+, ibiteganijwe, n'igipimo cy'ingaruka z'ubushoramari.
benefits.benefit6Desc: Huza inyandiko kugirango wemeze nyir'ubutaka, ube urubanza, urebe niba inyandiko iri mu buryo.
benefits.benefit7Desc: Ububiko bw'ishyurwa bufatanije n'amategeko kugirango ubucuruzi bw'ubutaka bube bwizewe.
benefits.benefit8Desc: Guhuza imiturire n'abaguzi bakwiye ukoresheje ikoranabuhanga rya AI.
benefits.benefit8Feature: 68% igipimo cyo guhuza no gukora ubucuruzi
benefits.benefit9Desc: Koresha LandVal kuri mudasobwa, tableti, cyangwa terefone ufite amakuru ahuriye hano hose.
benefits.benefit10Desc: Tangira ugupima agaciro gatatu ku kwezi ku Ubuntu. Vugurura iyo ukeneye ibiranga byinshi.
benefits.comparisonSubtitle: Reba impamvu ibihumbi bihindurira ku buryo buboneye
benefits.testimonialsSubtitle: Unyure mu batubarwa ba Leta n'abashoramari
benefits.testimonial1Quote: "Nk'umushoramari wo muri diaspora, LandVal yampaye icyizere cyo kugura ubutaka mu Rwanda nta kuba ngage. Kwemeza inyandiko byari ikintu cy'ingenzi."
benefits.testimonial2Quote: "Nagurishije umutiture wanjye 18% hejuru y'igiciro nasabaga mu byumweru 2. Algoritme yo guhuza yahuje n'abaguzi mpuzamahanga ako kanya."
benefits.testimonial3Quote: "Amakuru y'amateka y'ibiciro yamfashije kumenya imiturire y'ubuhinzi ifite igiciro gito. Ubushoramari bwanjye bwangereye 12% mu mezi 8 gusa!"
